extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic performance data were found in Figure 1a–e. Figure 1f is an Arrhenius plot and was skipped per instructions. Figures 2–5, 6a–d, and 7 are characterization/mechanistic plots and were skipped. Figure 6e includes CO2 conversion versus Al content together with Odefect/OH characterization; it duplicates the conversion trend already digitised from Figure 1a, so no separate duplicate records were added. H2/CO2 feed ratio and total flow were not stated in the provided main text.
